entries.proposition: Exhaustive scan of Supplementary Table 3 for the five WWOX probe set ids: seven hits, every one POSITIVE. In the VPA blocks, 219077_s_at is up 2.13-fold in UKK (p = 5.4e-16) and 223868_s_at is up 1.68-fold in UKN1 (p = 8.5e-5). The other five hits are other HDAC inhibitors: Entinostat (1.74 and 1.56 in UKK, 1.51 and 1.51 in UKN1) and SAHA (1.53 in UKK). No WWOX probe set appears with a negative fold change in any compound block of this sheet, and none appears in a mercurial block.
